approach.title:
A personal, discreet
and expert service.
approach.text: From a single picture to the contents of a house: a free valuation, careful cataloguing, and marketing to buyers around the world, handled by our specialists from first enquiry to the sale itself.

values.title: Free valuations
values.body: We conduct free valuations, Monday to Friday. You can visit our Chelsea saleroom, arrange a home valuation, or complete a form by clicking 'Request a valuation'.

values.title: No seller’s commission
values.body: A 2% + VAT administration fee, deducted only if your item sells.
